body:
This doesn't work for `Dictionary<MyEnum, Node>` (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/101801). It will take the enum hint_string `Value1,Value2,Value3` as the `class_name` which results in the following error when calling `Dictionary::set_typed`:

```
ERROR: Class names can only be set for type OBJECT.
```

I don't think you can assume that the hint_string will always be the class_name. I think that only works when the `PropertyHint` is `PROPERTY_HINT_NODE_TYPE` or `PROPERTY_HINT_RESOURCE_TYPE`.
